title: Uniform norm of a squared function
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $q>0$, and let $f\colon\Omega\to\mathbb R$. The uniform $L^{q/2}$ norm of the function $x\mapsto f(x)^2$ equals the square of the uniform $L^q$ norm of $f$.
